The '''Ottega sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Arthon/Legends|Arthon]], [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], [[Orocco]], [[Toskhowwl VI]], and [[Vessitoar]]. The sector included at least a part of the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]. It had 75 planets and 622 [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Ottega sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />

The Ottega sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Tendau Bendon/Legends|Tendau Bendon]] and in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Umwaw Moolis]].
